summary: Iteration 2 testing of DMS with real GPI_MASTER data. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass covering auth (sales01/sales02), dashboard totals (1442 vendors, 12 active salespersons), products (50 SKUs with new hsn_code/gst_pct/landing_price fields, category filter IPM=15/GPI=22/CANDY=9/FERRERO=4, STELLAR search), salespersons (15 with BLRAKDLT01-15 salesman_id), vendors (area filter Munnekollal 1=83, BAKERY case-insensitive search), new /api/my-vendors endpoint (sp1=83 Munnekollal 1, sp2=102 Munnekollal 2, admin 403), salesperson sale flow (blocked without allocation, allocation->sale flow works, dashboard reflects sale), and reports. Frontend: login page shows real stats (1400+ vendors, 15 salespersons, 50 products), no quick-fill-sales (only admin), Admin Products page shows 50 SKUs with HSN/GST%/Landing/MRP/PTR columns, category tabs filter correctly (verified all 4 counts + STELLAR search=13), Admin Salespersons has SE ID column with BLRAKDLT01..15, Admin Vendors has server-side area filter + search showing 1442 vendors, Salesperson RecordSale/Collections load and call /api/my-vendors (verified 83 Munnekollal 1 vendors for sales01).

minor.issue: total_salespersons returns 12 (active) but problem statement expected 13. This is actually correct per /app/memory/test_credentials.md which shows 12 active + 3 inactive (BLRAKDLT04, 05, 12) = 15 total. Problem statement wording was slightly off (12 active, not 13).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> element - caused by dev instrumentation attributes on <option> children in Vendors.jsx line 98 (route filter select). Cosmetic dev-mode console warning; doesn't affect production build or functionality.

action_items: None required. All 25 backend tests pass. All frontend flows verified end-to-end.

Optional: Consider updating problem statement to reflect 12 active salespersons (not 13) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Or activate BLRAKDLT12 (currently inactive placeholder 'Pending SE') if you want 13.
Optional cosmetic: hydration warning about <span> in <option> from Vendors.jsx dev tooling - use plain string children in <option> to silence it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_products: 'category' filter maps to 'brand' field (line 127). This is fine per current data model but naming inconsistency between UI (category) and DB (brand) could confuse future developers - consider renaming or adding an alias.

server.py my_vendors (line 288-291): building a nested $and with query.copy() is unnecessarily complex; simpler to build a single dict merging area+ regex or use $and cleanly. Currently works but is fragile.
server.py /api/my-vendors returns 5000 vendor cap via to_list(5000) - fine for current data but if a route ever exceeds this it will silently truncate.
Products.jsx displays GST as `(p.gst_pct * 100).toFixed(0)%` assuming decimal storage (0.4 -> 40%). Add-Product form label correctly says 'as decimal, e.g. 0.4' - consistent. Good.

Login page bottom-left stats are hardcoded strings '1400+', '15', '50' not fetched from API - if data changes these will drift. Consider fetching a public /api/stats endpoint or computing at build time.
seed.py is now only admin-seed - good. Ensure import_data.py is idempotent for future re-runs (should upsert, not duplicate); worth checking though I didn't run it.
Frontend uses `credentials: 'include'` implicitly via axios cookies — verified by successful /api/my-vendors XHR from browser context. Good.
Admin dashboard 'Vendors' card shows '1442' without thousands separator; consider using a locale-aware formatter for consistency with '₹232' style formatting.
Products page subtitle reads '13 SKUs in catalog' when STELLAR search shown - this is the filtered count, could be confusing. Consider showing 'Showing 13 of 50 SKUs' when filter/search active.
